**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

Although §13's visible text (p0088) is only an ownership statement, the section continues on p0090–p0093 with a genuine Garman-side IP indemnity: a warranty of ownership/no encumbrances, an indemnity for all Losses (including settlement sums and reasonable legal fees) for breach of that warranty, and the standard infringement remedies (procure, procure equivalent, replace/modify). There is no customer indemnity for Garman's software, no customer-side exclusions, and §15 expressly disapplies the limitation of liability to §13 breaches — so no cap swallows the indemnity.

Noted for negotiation, not flagged: no express duty to defend/control defence, no refund remedy, no limbs for breach of law, Garman-caused data breach or gross negligence/wilful misconduct, and a tight ten-calendar-day notice requirement.
